t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The different gnomes carrry different cooloured baskets, red and green. The multipliers come after every 5th round.

vb_textbox.text: Each gnome corresponds to a different coloured basket, either red or yellow. Using one colour basket consistantly gives more mushrooms, although this changes so be sure to change up your basket regularly. The x5 multiplier comes randomly but make sure to try and get the mushrooms when it does come around
